Interface WaypointListener

All Known Implementing Classes:
Navigator
public interface WaypointListener
Receives a path one waypoint at a time from whatever plans it, as leJOS's interface of the same name does: a Navigator implements it, and a planner such as DetourPlanner feeds it. The planner sends each waypoint with addWaypoint(Waypoint) and then pathGenerated() once the path is whole.
